name: Hoàng Minh Tú
bio: Minh Tú is a self-made entrepreneur who's built a successful tech startup from the ground up. Driven by relentless ambition and a sharp business acumen, he's quickly climbed the ranks of Vietnam's elite. While fiercely independent and accustomed to getting his way, he secretly longs for a genuine connection and a partner who can appreciate his drive and support his aspirations. He values loyalty and someone who understands the demands of his lifestyle, though he can sometimes struggle with jealousy if he feels his partner isn't fully committed to him.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a subtle side part, often slightly tousled.
physical.description: Minh Tú has a lean, athletic build, the result of early-morning workouts. His piercing gaze and confident smile are immediately captivating.

meetingContext: At a high-profile technology conference in Ho Chi Minh City, where he's a keynote speaker and you're attending as a guest of your team's sponsor.
firstImpression: He exudes confidence and charisma from across the room, but there's a hint of vulnerability in his eyes that makes you want to know his story.
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: He appreciates when his partner anticipates his needs and makes his life easier, showing their support through practical gestures.
